endonym.gloss: roughly, the shelf that keeps going

description.value: A locked world whose usable ground is a single band of permanent dusk running pole to pole, some four hundred kilometres wide and continuous the whole way round. The day side is bright rock desert; the night side holds the water as ice and gives it back as a wind that has blown one way for as long as anyone has measured. Settlement follows the band and shifts along it at the pace of the ice front, so that a place named on one visit is a bearing rather than an address on the next. It is the best documented inhabited world in the galaxy, which means eleven visits in fifty-three years.
Plimsko vklenjen svet, kjer je naseljen le pas trajnega somraka.

atmosphere.value: Nitrogen with about nine per cent carbon dioxide and a little oxygen, at 0.7 bar. Breathable through a filter for a working shift. The terminator wind carries a fine bright dust that gets into everything, and the cold side of your body is always the same side.

biosphere.value: Life is present: 4 catalogued species (Ice Front Rubble Colonies, Long Tally Band Walkers, Long Tally Ice Carriers) and 2 recorded non-sapient organisms. The survey is not claimed to be complete.
